title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1668: Endless slaughter (2)

section.p: At the same time.
Allheaven Battlefield.

Everyone was still immersed in their shock at humanity’s attack on the celestial chasm race when several new phenomena appeared. Nobody had bothered to prevent the phenomena from spreading out of the Human Realm.
And thus, two projections appeared in the sky before falling upon the Immortal Realm.
Chaos unfolded in the Immortal Realm.
Two immortal kings had fallen.
Tiangu blanked out.
Yes. He was caught by complete surprise.
Snow King and Fire King…dead?
They died?
He hadn’t even gotten the chance to recover from his shock at what Great Qin King and the others were doing when a new shocking event hit him.
“Damn it!”
Tiangu’s furious roar rang out, “Snow King and Fire King have perished. The humans have discovered their hiding place!”
Those words shocked countless people.

The divines, devils, nethers, and dragons were greatly alarmed. Tiangu continued, “We can’t allow them to kill our people in isolation. Notify them! Have them attack together! Everyone, the humans have gone mad. Qin Guang and the others are attacking the celestial chasms. We will be the next. It’s time to make your choice, everyone!”

The Divine Pseudo Emperor’s voice rang out, “Help the celestial chasm race. Exterminate the human race. Immortal Emperor, we will surround the Celestial Chasm Realm and smash their realm barrier apart to allow the celestial chasm experts to escape. Devil Emperor, Nether Emperor, and Dragon Emperor. The three of you will attack the Human Realm.”
As Daofuses, they were naturally decisive. It didn’t take them long to decide on a course of action. Each of them stepped forth, followed by a large number of Invincibles.

The Devil Pseudo Emperor was stepping forth as well, followed by over thirty Invincibles as he flew toward the Human Realm. This time, there was no need for them to worry about Great Zhou King’s surprise attack.

About seventy and eighty Invincibles and three Daofuses started heading toward the Human Realm. At the same time, dozens of Invincibles and two Daofuses started heading toward the Celestial Chasm Realm.

They aimed to smash the realm barrier apart and release the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor. The humans would be a lot less scary out in the Allheaven Battlefield. After all, the rest of them would be subjected to the suppressive pressure of the Celestial Chasm Realm if they had to fight inside.
At the same time.
The other Daofuses were deep in contemplation.
The old turtle, Heavenly Overseer Marquis, big furball, Hou Pseudo Emperor, Spatial Beast Pseudo Emperor, Primordial Giant Pseudo Emperor, Phoenix Pseudo Emperor…
All were deep in thought.
What should they do now?
A large number of Invincibles started emerging from the various major realms. Many of the Invincibles long thought dead had resurfaced as well.
The humans…had gone to war yet again.
War was upon them.

This was the prelude to the tenth epochal war. The war over four hundred years ago did not count as that was merely humanity’s resistance against invasion. At the time, they had fought with the intention of dealing as much damage as possible while ignoring all that was happening in the Human Realm. That was a choice they made out of desperation.

At the time, the myriad races had withdrawn as they did not wish to suffer too much losses that early. But this time, things were different. This time, the humans were the invaders. They had invaded the Celestial Chasm Realm and killed nine…no, the tenth Invincible had just died. A rain of blood was already falling from the sky.
The deaths of ten celestial chasm Invincibles were even causing storms in the Fate Realm.
Right as the tenth celestial chasm Invincible died.
Fate Realm.
A storm started brewing atop a certain mountain peak.
The Fate Pseudo Emperor emerged out of thin air and looked up at the sky. A face had appeared in the sky. With boundless fury, that face roared.
“Has the war began in the Myriad Realms?”
The Fate Pseudo Emperor answered, “This is a prelude of war.”
“Did the humans start it?”
“Yes.”
“Damn it!” The furious face questioned, “Why did the war start so early? It hasn’t even been a thousand years!”
Yes. It hadn’t even been a thousand years since the start of the tenth epoch. None of them had expected the war to start so early.

The myriad races had intended to suppress the humans for now. The final war would only begin after a thousand years. That would be the best course of action. And the thousand-year limit was still quite far away.
The Fate Pseudo Emperor said calmly, “The humans are in decline. They are unwilling to suffer elimination. Thus, they took a risk and attacked the celestial chasm race.”
“Damn them all!”
The furious face struggled to descend from the sky, but bolts of lightning appeared in the sky, preventing him from coming down.
The Fate Pseudo Emperor continued calmly, “Abyss Marquis, I suggest you wait. It’s too early for you to descend. You won’t be able to survive the tribulation.”
“Damn them all! They should all die!” The furious face said, “Fateless, go! Go to the Celestial Chasm Realm and kill the humans!”
The Fate Pseudo Emperor frowned slightly and said, “Enough, Abyss Marquis. I am only here to update you, not serve you. Do you have the misconception that I am under your command?”
The furious Abyss Marquis said, “Those are humans! The myriad races will never see peace as long as they are still around!”
The two of them were fellow Daofuses. In the ancient past, a marquis was a Daofuse. In the tenth epoch, a Pseudo Emperor was a Daofuse. Thus, they were essentially equals.

The Fate Pseudo Emperor nodded and said, “Yes, I understand. But my race only serves the heavens. Your race has betrayed us. We are no longer one. Abyss Marquis, I’ll be taking my leave if this is all. Of course, you are free to come down if this displeases you.”
“Damn them all!”

Seeing the furiously shouting marquis, the Fate Pseudo Emperor laughed and said, “If you keep this up, I wouldn’t mind taking this opportunity to punish the traitor of the fate race and remove Soulvenge.”

Naturally, those words further infuriated the marquis. But the marquis was able to calm himself down before saying, “Very well. Fateless, just you wait. Wait for my arrival. I will settle scores with you then.”

The Fate Pseudo Emperor chuckled and said, “What’s the point of a stupid threat like this? The fate race has just as many experts up there as your race. Don’t forget that your race is merely a race of traitors. The humans are your enemies. Do not dream of involving the fates or I will be the one to settle scores with you.”

With a contemptuous smile, he walked away and said, “Feel free to come down if you are feeling particularly brave. Otherwise, shut your mouth. What are you doing shouting up there? Are you showing off your strength in front of me? Really?”
The face in the sky was incomparably furious.
Damn him!
Damn his arrogance
Damn it! How did the celestial chasms lose so many Eternals? Damn the humans! Why did the humans target them?
Also, wasn’t Soulvenge already a Daofuse? Was he a piece of trash?
The humans had yet to produce a Daofuse this epoch! How could Soulvenge lose?
Fool!
What about the immortals, devils, divines, and dragons?
Why did they let the humans do this?
With boundless fury, he attempted to descend several times. Alas, the bolts of lightning kept stopping him, leaving him flustered and exasperated. Ultimately, he decided to not brave the tribulation.

Sure, he could always descend forcefully. But the heavenly laws were still quite powerful at this point in time. He was worried that the heavenly laws would injure him heavily after his descent. That would be troublesome. The war had barely started. He couldn’t allow himself to get injured so early in the war.
“Things should be fine since Soulvenge is still alive…”
Finally, the furious face faded from the sky.

Meanwhile, the Fate Pseudo Emperor was shaking his head with contempt. What a coward. Why didn’t the Abyss Marquis force his way down? If he was too cowardly to come down, why bother throwing all those threats? What a clown.
Then, the Fate Pseudo Emperor stared in a certain direction. His gaze seemed to piece through space itself to land on the Human Realm.
He sighed.
The humans…had declared war.

Perhaps this was a good thing for the human race. Since they didn’t know if they still had any experts remaining up there, they might as well seize the initiative down here. The human race had suffered a disastrous defeat during the ninth epoch. This was likely the final bit of strength they could muster.

Rather than waiting for the experts from the world beyond that might or might not exist anymore, they might as well attack and slaughter all their enemies down here. Su Yu and his alliance with the ancient cities were the perfect opportunity for humanity to do something. In a way, the human race had picked the perfect timing to act.
Qin Guang and the others were surprisingly bold and decisive.
Human Realm.

Su Yu received a voice transmission from Zhu Tiandao, “A report has arrived from the Allheaven Prefecture. The devils, nethers, and dragons are coming with three Daofuses and over seventy Invincibles. The divines and immortals are heading toward the Celestial Chasm Realm with two Daofuses and over forty Invincibles.”
So many of them.
Five Daofuses and over a hundred Invincibles.

Including the celestial chasms, humanity would be faced with six Daofuses and over a hundred and forty Invincibles. This was a far stronger force than what humanity could muster. To make things worse, there was also an unknown number of enemies hidden within the Human Realm.
Just then, Su Yu received his answer.
Numerous powerful figures emerged from all over the Human Realm.
All the hidden enemies had received their orders.
They had decided to show themselves.
Today, they would attack from the inside and the outside and break through the defenses of humanity.

With Great Qin King and the others gone, the Human Realm was far weaker than before. They could either kill or force Su Yu to flee to the Death Realm. Or they could even cause an outbreak of death spirits in the Human Realm through Su Yu.
This was a golden opportunity for them to act. As for the ancient guardians, they would be trapped in their cities again with Su Yu gone.

Even when Su Yu was still around, they weren’t as fearful of the ancient guardians as before since Su Yu was still in the Human Realm. When the ancient guardians left their cities, the amount of death qi in Su Yu’s body would increase exponentially, potentially causing a death spirit outbreak right inside the Human Realm.
“Wow. They sure are generous when it comes to dealing with me.”
Su Yu sighed.
Just then, the voices of numerous experts rang out.
“Su Yu, die!”
“Humans, kill Su Yu and you will be spared!”
“Several Emperors are on their way. Humanity will end here!”
The voices of the various experts reverberated in the air.
The battle erupted.
Great Yuan King and the others started fighting.
As for Su Yu, he sighed again.
Why were the myriad races so generous?
Twenty-two Invincibles. Including the two he killed earlier, there were twenty-four of them hidden in the Human Realm.

Including the two dead immortal kings, the immortals had planted eight Invincibles in the Human Realm. The devils had planted four, the divines had planted five, the nethers had planted two, the dragons had planted two, and even the celestial chasms had planted one. As for the other two, one came from the phoenix race while the other came from the…spirit race.

The spirit race was also a major race. But it had been staying away from all the previous conflicts between humanity and the major races. The spirit race was a race of translucent beings. Like the five elementals, the spirits were also born from nature. They could be further divided into plant spirits, mountain spirits, river spirits, and so on. Strictly speaking, there was a connection between the spirits and the five elementals. After all, some among the spirits also controlled the five elements.

Su Yu had not expected to see a spirit Invincible here as well. It was clear the spirits were harboring evil designs against humanity as well. They wouldn’t have planted an Invincible in the Human Realm otherwise.
Su Yu had never considered the spirit race an enemy race before. Was the Spirit Pseudo Emperor joining the battle today as well?
Su Yu had no idea. He only knew that he was currently under massive pressure. Too few human Invincibles were left in the Human Realm. Meanwhile, enemy Invincibles were appearing everywhere.

Alongside the Invincibles, numerous Sunmoons and Mountainseas were appearing as well. The moment they emerged, they scattered in all directions. Zhu Tiandao and the others hurriedly moved as well. At the same time, numerous people looked at Great Zhou King and the others hopefully.
As a response, Su Yu smiled and said, “There is no rush. Great Zhou King and the others will be on standby until the situation gets dangerous.”
Why were these people looking at these clones?
It would be pointless.
Naturally, not everyone was stupid. Realization dawned on some of them as horrified expressions appeared on their faces.
Those were fakes!
